preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 10.
For each test case, the number of people n must be between 2 and 1000, and the number of chains m must be between 1 and n.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= a_i <= 10000 for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: The weights of the fridges must be non-negative integers not exceeding 10000.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if not solution else True
postconditions.description: If no solution exists, output -1; otherwise, output the minimum total cost and the connections.
The number of connections output must be exactly m.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in connections)
postconditions.description: Each connection must be between two distinct fridges.
